about.heading: About Us
about.heroSubtitle: We support European municipalities and B2B organisations in translating sustainability policy into structured governance, measurable outcomes, and operational implementation.
about.whoTitle: Independent ESG advisory for complex public environments.
about.whoBody: We are a small, expert-led consultancy specialising in sustainability strategy, governance alignment, and regulatory implementation across the Netherlands and neighbouring European markets. We work with municipalities and private-sector organisations operating in regulated, multi-stakeholder environments. Our role is to structure ESG ambition into coherent frameworks that withstand public scrutiny, regulatory review, and operational reality. Sustainability in public contexts demands precision. We bring that structure.
about.contextBody: The European regulatory environment is evolving rapidly — from the European Green Deal to CSRD reporting obligations and taxonomy alignment. Municipalities face increasing expectations around transparency, climate adaptation, procurement sustainability, and measurable impact. We help organisations interpret these requirements pragmatically and embed them into governance, reporting, and operational systems.

approachSteps.title: 01 — Regulatory & policy mapping
approachSteps.body: We analyse applicable EU and national frameworks, local policy ambitions, and stakeholder expectations.

approachSteps.title: 02 — Double materiality & risk assessment
approachSteps.body: We identify material ESG factors and translate them into actionable priorities.

approachSteps.title: 03 — Governance & operational alignment
approachSteps.body: We integrate ESG objectives into procurement processes, internal controls, reporting structures, and cross-departmental workflows.

approachSteps.title: 04 — Monitoring & reporting systems
approachSteps.body: We establish measurable KPIs and reporting structures aligned with European regulatory standards.

focusList: ESG strategy for municipalities and public-sector organisations

whyList: Deep understanding of EU sustainability regulation
